newsitem.title: CHINA: China Shanxi aluminium project starts operation.
newsitem.headline: China Shanxi aluminium project starts operation.

text.p: The first phase of an electrolytic aluminium project in China's northern province of Shanxi started operation recently, the Economic Information Daily said on Tuesday.
The first phase of the project, owned by Yuncheng Shanhe Aluminium Co, was expected to produce 12,500 tonnes of electrolytic aluminium a year, the newspaper said.
Annual output value was estimated at 200 million yuan ($24.1 million), it said but gave no further details.
